cohort: The study enrolled 1770 infants born after 20 weeks of gestation at a tertiary hospital in Taiwan between January 2019 and December 2021, divided into an ART pregnancy group (n=289) and a natural pregnancy group (n=1481).
finding: After adjusting for maternal and infant characteristics, ART itself was not associated with an increased risk of adverse neonatal outcomes, including mortality, complications, and congenital anomalies, despite ART pregnancies initially showing higher rates of multiple births and associated adverse outcomes.
